## Top integrations

Entity counts come from the `platform` field on each entity entry; device counts come from the `integrations` array on each device entry. These are different fields and may not align one-to-one (a device can declare multiple integrations; some platforms like `template` and `automation` produce entities with no associated device).

---

`proxmoxve` is the dominant integration by a wide margin — 455 entities (41% of the registry) from 22 devices, driven by the per-VM/LXC/disk sensor explosion that Proxmox VE integration generates. `ugreen` punches above its weight too: 132 entities from only 5 devices (~26 entities/device), consistent with deep NAS telemetry (pool health, per-disk SMART, fans, thermals). The most operationally concerning stat is area assignment coverage: 92 of 139 devices (66%) have no area, which limits area-scoped automations and dashboard grouping. The `sensor` domain alone accounts for 44% of all entities, almost entirely from infrastructure monitoring rather than smart-home sensors.
